name: Anthropic: Claude Sonnet 5.5
quirks: Through OpenRouter it rejects a forced tool_choice (HTTP 400); leave tool choice on auto.
Tends to add tests, docs and small files it wasn't asked for (provider docs).
May call a tool with the wrong letter case or a near-miss parameter name: read the error and retry with the exact name.
tips: Run a real check before reporting a change done.
When asked for ideas, options or a plan, give them and stop until told to build.
bench: As the reviewer in QuorX's build benchmark it agreed with the benchmark judge 7 of 7 times, for about $0.02 a build. Also a strong builder (pricier).
